sourceFile: 58.BRS-161014 Report Test improve NG hearing rate_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but incorrectly merges many independent test reports and changed factors into one case.
issues: Multiple unrelated changed factors combined under one cf
Baseline/test pairings violate date and subgroup keys
Review title/purpose tied to NG VP sheet but outcomes cite other reports
Header/measurement candidates are treated as outcomes without judged comparison
Some cited rows are not shown in review context, limiting verification
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases by sheet/report and changed factor
For each case define one baseline and one test condition context
Re-pair rows using same date, mold, lot, method, and assembly mode keys
Remove header-only measurement candidates unless tied to real changed-condition data
Add purpose/content/result/decision rows for every retained case
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient until grouping and comparable pairs are corrected.
